verdict.rationale: Drata is a SaaS compliance platform with AI features (an MCP server and AI-agent workflows), so asking whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack contains no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a no-training commitment. The community items about the device agent concern installing it on personal hardware, not AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
